PickupRadius.description: Gather coins across a wider area.

ToolCapacity.description: Move more coins with every tool cycle.

ToolRange.description: Reach deeper gold from farther away.

DepositSpeed.description: Feed carried gold into the bank faster.

CarryCapacity.description: Improve your pockets and all owned bags.

RecallCoil.name: WORMHOLE COIL
RecallCoil.description: Right-click recalls your deployed vacuum grenade from anywhere, even through walls. No earlier utility purchases required.

Singularity.name: SINGULARITY
Singularity.description: 3,000 coins/sec and a 5m sweep. Gather the final scattered gold.

Shovel.name: SHOVEL
Shovel.description: Hold left mouse for close directional scoops through dense gold. Learn Jackhammer for a charged right-mouse slam where you aim. Unlock for 1 point after collecting 1,500 coins.

Vortex.name: GOLD WINCH
Vortex.description: Press LMB to hook a seam, then hold to reel in gold. If the cable breaks or the seam runs dry, release and click again to recast.

GravityCoupler.name: GRAVITY COUPLER
GravityCoupler.description: 600x base deposit speed. A fast final cash-in at any hopper.

CoinRailgun.name: COIN RAILGUN
CoinRailgun.description: Click or hold to punch a crisp 90-coin line through gold every 0.45 seconds. A 12m beam; walls stop it.

HydraulicCoupler.name: HYDRAULIC COUPLER
HydraulicCoupler.description: 240x base deposit speed. Keeps unloading brief as hauls grow.

DrillVac.name: DRILLVAC
DrillVac.description: Hold to bore straight down: 100 coins per pulse while you move freely. Watch the heat gauge and release to cool. Pushing past 2 seconds of heat overheats the drill for 3 seconds.

HopperPack.name: HOPPER PACK
HopperPack.description: +11,000 carry. 15,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.

CoinRake.name: COIN RAKE
CoinRake.description: Hold LMB and walk to rake up gold. Each moving stroke sweeps up to 16 coins; standing still stops collection.

SpringBoots.name: SPRING BOOTS
SpringBoots.description: Jump 65% higher. Passive; no fuel, no slot, no prerequisites.

SeismicThumper.name: SEISMIC THUMPER
SeismicThumper.description: Click on the ground or in midair to slam down. Bigger drops unleash wider shockwaves and far bigger harvests, up to 82,000 coins. Bag overflow banks automatically. 3-second recovery after landing.

PressureCoupler.name: PRESSURE COUPLER
PressureCoupler.description: 30x base deposit speed. Replaces the liner's 8x bonus.

VaultPack.name: VAULT PACK
VaultPack.description: +90,000 carry. 180,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.

PrismRail.name: RICOCHET PRISM
PrismRail.description: Click or hold to launch fast, growing orbs. Direct hits scoop up to 900 coins; wall bounces widen the blast and raise it to 1,800.

Vacuum.name: PRESSURE VACUUM
Vacuum.description: Click to start suction. Hold LMB to raise pressure, release to lower it. Track the moving green zone; strain recovers slowly. Losing control spills your bag and triggers an 8-second repair.

CoinShotgun.name: COIN BLUNDERBUSS
CoinShotgun.description: Click or hold for a chunky 280-coin spread every 0.6 seconds. A quick pump and a recoil hop keep you moving.

Pouch.name: POUCH
Pouch.description: +500 carry and 3x base deposit speed. Longer trips, quicker unloading.

TeslaFork.name: TESLA STORMFORK
TeslaFork.description: Hold to crack lightning into gold. Each strike automatically chains across up to four nearby patches, 180 coins each. No marking or charging.

VacuumGrenade.name: VACUUM GRENADE
VacuumGrenade.description: G throws it with any tool equipped. Stores up to 1,200 coins. Walk over to collect, or right-click to recall through a clear path.

HoverRig.name: BALLOON RIG
HoverRig.description: Hold jump while falling to float gently down. Steer across gaps; release to drop normally.

DoubleJumpJets.name: POP-JET BELT
DoubleJumpJets.description: Press jump again in mid-air for one extra jump. Recharges on landing. Works without spring boots.

MagneticBoots.name: MAGNETIC BOOTS
MagneticBoots.description: Walking over gold sweeps up to 6 nearby coins every half second. Stops when your bag is full.

HaulFrame.name: HAUL FRAME
HaulFrame.description: +25,000 carry. 40,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.

TurbineCoupler.name: TURBINE COUPLER
TurbineCoupler.description: 90x base deposit speed. Pour large hauls into any hopper.

Magnet.name: MAGNET
Magnet.description: Hold left mouse for surface pulls at long reach. Purchase Magnetic Pulse  to unlock a right-mouse burst. Unlock for 1 point after collecting 3,000 coins; shovel optional.

Backpack.name: BACKPACK
Backpack.description: +3,250 carry. 4,000 total with the pouch, before skill bonuses.

QuickDump.name: QUICK-DUMP LINER
QuickDump.description: 8x base deposit speed at every hopper. Strongest coupler applies.

SprintSoles.name: ROCKET SOLES
SprintSoles.description: Move 25% faster. Shorten bank trips or race along the galleries. Always active.

Cyclone.name: POCKET BANK
Cyclone.description: Hold LMB to preview; release on green to place. Collects visible gold within 12 m; Local branch extends this to 16 m. Banks 30 coins/sec plus 3 per 1,000 bag capacity, up to 150/sec. Hold F nearby to relocate.

CargoHarness.name: CARGO HARNESS
CargoHarness.description: +50,000 carry. 90,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.

TinyMagnet.name: TINY MAGNET
TinyMagnet.description: Click for a snappy 12-coin pull. Hold to keep snapping gold into your hand. No charging.

GravityAnchor.name: GOLD TRANSMITTER
GravityAnchor.description: Click to open a rift in aimed gold up to 18m away and pull up to 720 coins into your bag. Hold to repeat every 0.65 seconds. A broad 3m scoop, with no charge or player teleport.
